title: My First Haircut
blurb: Meet the stylist, choose a seat, see the cape and the tools, hear the scissors and clippers, and ask for a break.

text.title: For the grown-up reading along
text.std: {Name} can read this book before {their} haircut, as many times as {they} {v:likes|like}. Every salon is different. Ask the stylist what {name} can choose, and agree on a break signal first.
text.easy: {Name} can read this book before {their} haircut, as many times as {they} {v:likes|like}. Every salon is different. Ask the stylist what {name} can choose, and agree on a break signal first.

variants.std: Read this book together before the haircut, as many times as you like. Every salon is different. Ask the stylist what choices there are, and agree on a break signal first.
variants.easy: Read this book together before the haircut, as many times as you like. Every salon is different. Ask the stylist what choices there are, and agree on a break signal first.

back.alt: Back cover with a note for the grown-up.

text.title: My First Haircut
text.std: A story for {name}
text.easy: A story for {name}

noName.std: A story about a first haircut
noName.easy: A story about a first haircut

pages.alt: Title page. {child} waves hello.

text.std: My name is {name}. Soon I will get a haircut.
text.easy: I am {name}. I will get a haircut.

noName.std: Soon I will get a haircut.

pages.alt: {child} stands at home near a calendar with one day circled.

text.std: Hair grows a little every day. A haircut makes it shorter or neater.
text.easy: Hair grows. A haircut makes it shorter.

pages.alt: {child} stands beside pictures of long hair and a pair of scissors.

text.std: A grown-up I know will come with me.
text.easy: My grown-up comes with me.

pages.alt: {child} stands beside a grown-up at home.

text.std: We go to the hair salon or barbershop.
text.easy: We go to the hair salon.

pages.alt: {child} and a grown-up arrive outside a hair salon with a striped awning.

text.std: Inside, there may be mirrors, chairs, and other people.
text.easy: Inside there are chairs and mirrors.

pages.alt: {child} and a grown-up stand inside the salon waiting area.

text.std: It may smell like shampoo. I may hear talking, music, or a hair dryer.
text.easy: There may be new smells and sounds.

pages.alt: Two picture cards: a sound symbol and a spray bottle.

text.std: I might wait for a little while. I can bring something that helps me wait.
text.easy: I might wait a little.

pages.alt: {child} sits in the waiting area next to a grown-up.

text.std: The person who cuts hair is called a stylist or a barber. They say hello.
text.easy: The stylist says hello.

pages.alt: A stylist in an apron waves hello to {child}.

text.std: I can choose where to sit, if there is a choice. A big chair, a small chair, or my grown-up’s lap.
text.easy: I can ask where I can sit.

variants.std: I can ask where to sit, if there is a choice. I can ask to stay in my own chair.
variants.easy: I can ask to stay in my own chair.

pages.alt: Three picture cards: a big salon chair, a small chair and a heart for a lap.

text.std: The big chair may go up and down.
text.easy: The big chair may go up.

variants.std: The stylist finds a good spot by the mirror for my chair.
variants.easy: My chair goes by the mirror.

pages.alt: {child} is seated in front of a round mirror. The stylist stands nearby.

text.std: The stylist puts a cape around me. It keeps hair off my clothes.
text.easy: I wear a cape. It keeps hair off me.

pages.alt: {child} wears a teal haircut cape. A card shows the cape.

text.std: The cape may feel snug at my neck. I can ask to make it looser.
text.easy: I can ask to loosen the cape.

pages.alt: {child} sits in the cape between a grown-up and the stylist.

text.std: The stylist can show me the tools: a comb, scissors, a spray bottle, and clippers.
text.easy: The stylist can show me the tools.

pages.alt: Four picture cards: a comb, scissors, a spray bottle and clippers.

text.std: The spray bottle makes my hair damp. The mist may feel cool.
text.easy: Water mist may feel cool.

pages.alt: The stylist sprays a little water mist near {child}.

text.std: The comb moves through my hair. It may tug a little.
text.easy: The comb may tug a little.

pages.alt: The stylist combs hair for {child}. A card shows a comb.

text.std: Scissors go snip, snip. Little bits of hair fall down.
text.easy: Scissors go snip, snip.

pages.alt: Little bits of hair fall to the floor while {child} sits in the cape.

text.std: The stylist may use clippers. They buzz and hum. I can ask to hear them first.
text.easy: Clippers buzz. I can ask to hear them first.

variants.std: The stylist may use clippers. They buzz and hum. I can ask to hear them first, and ask if I can keep my ear defenders on.
variants.easy: Clippers buzz. I can ask to keep my ear defenders on.

pages.alt: Sound marks show the clippers buzzing near {child}.

text.std: Hair may land on my neck or face. It can feel itchy. A soft brush or towel wipes it away.
text.easy: Hair can feel itchy. A soft brush wipes it away.

pages.alt: A card shows a soft brush for wiping away loose hair.

text.std: If I need a break, I can raise my hand or say, “Break, please.”
text.easy: I can ask for a break.

variants.std: If I need a break, I can raise my hand or use my device to say, “Break, please.”
variants.easy: I can raise my hand or use my device.

pages.alt: {child} practices raising a hand next to a card that says break.

text.std: During a break, the tools rest. I can take a breath or have a drink.
text.easy: In a break, the tools rest.

pages.alt: The tools rest on a cart while {child} takes a break.

text.std: The stylist holds up a mirror. I can look if I want to.
text.easy: I can look in a mirror if I want.

pages.alt: The stylist holds up a hand mirror for {child}.

text.std: The cape comes off. We say goodbye.
text.easy: The cape comes off. Goodbye!

pages.alt: {child} and the stylist wave goodbye.

text.std: Now I know what I might see, hear, and feel at a haircut.
text.easy: Now I know about haircuts.

pages.alt: {child} waves under a star, scissors and a heart. The end.
